presets.label: Barely There
presets.description: An almost imperceptible creep that keeps the frame alive without anyone noticing the camera.
askedAs: almost no movement but not static

presets.label: Slow Pull Back
presets.description: A gentle reverse dolly that eases the scene away and opens up breathing room.

presets.label: Cinematic Push
presets.description: A deliberate, deeper push-in that builds tension like a film dolly move.

presets.label: Quick Punch
presets.description: A fast, energetic push that lands the zoom early for snappy, short scenes.

presets.label: Wide Retreat
presets.description: A pronounced, steady pull-out that reveals the full scene as it settles.
